data.narrative:
True Anomaly is a Defense & Security frontier-tech company at SPAC stage, currently valued at $2.2B following $1B+ in total fundraising. The peer universe comprises 16 same-sector, similar-valuation-tier comparables, split between 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private companies including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

The peer-median method is the primary applicable triangulation approach given available data. Across the 16-company peer set, the median valuation is $2.3B, with a range spanning $1.0B (floor) to $9.2B (Saronic, Series D). Notable high-end comparables include Quantum-Systems at $8.0B (Series C), Flock Safety at $7.5B (Series G), Chaos Industries at $4.5B (Series D), and Skydio at $4.4B (Series F). This peer-median method directly implies a $2.3B valuation.

The triangulated fair-value range is $2.0B–$2.7B (median $2.3B), which encompasses True Anomaly's current $2.2B valuation. Key uncertainties include valuation divergence within the defense-tech peer set—the $8.2B spread between Quantum-Systems and the $1.0B floor suggests stage, technology maturity, and revenue traction drive material variation. With only one method supported by available data, sensitivity to peer selection and sector-specific revenue multiples remains material.
